items.title: Kering: Gucci Q2 decline eases to -3% comparable, execution levers 'on track'
items.summary: Trade outlet's rundown of Kering's H1 2026 results published July 30: H1 group revenue EUR7.22bn comparable, fashion and leather goods (80 percent of revenue) down 1 percent in H1 with Gucci down 5 percent comparable for the half but improving to a milder 3 percent decline in Q2 alone -- the brand's best sequential print in several quarters. Kering Eyewear and Jewelry (Boucheron, Pomellato) grew strongly. CEO Luca de Meo called it evidence the ReconKering turnaround plan's execution levers are on track.

items.title: Kering shares jump as Gucci stabilizes
items.summary: Wire report on the market reaction to Kering's Q2 print: shares closed up more than 10 percent in early Paris trading after Gucci's revenue decline slowed more than analysts expected (this article does not state the more specific 16.9%/biggest-in-24-years figure reported elsewhere in today's pool by WWD, item NA-2026-07-31-001 — cite WWD for that specific figure, not this URL). CEO Luca de Meo's on-record quote from this article: 'Kering delivered improved performance in the second quarter, with revenue returning to growth. Across the Group, we are seeing early signs of progress in brand desirability, commercial momentum and operating performance.' No Asia-Pacific ex-Japan regional breakdown or China/Korea-specific commentary is present in this source; an earlier draft summary attributing a 5 percent APAC ex-Japan decline and a 'discipline failed' quote to this article could not be verified against the source and has been removed.

items.title: Thai forum thread debates Gucci price vs. quality under Demna era
items.summary: Pantip.com thread (Thailand's largest general discussion board) with users comparing Gucci's post-price-hike positioning against Prada and Bottega Veneta; several commenters say Gucci leather goods 'feel thinner' than five years ago for a similar price point, while others push back citing the new Borsetto and Paparazzo bags as a genuine quality improvement. Mixed grassroots community sentiment, not brand-driven activation.

items.title: TikTok clips of Gucci Marina Bay Sands crowd and store revamp circulate
items.summary: Aggregated TikTok discovery page collecting recent user clips filmed outside the renovated Gucci Marina Bay Sands boutique (wood-clad walls, horse murals, dimmer lighting); largely fan/consumer-generated footage reacting positively to the store redesign and new Jackie bag iterations, with some clips noting long queues and crowd-control frustration during peak weekend hours.

items.title: Amazedaily recap: Generation Gucci activation still driving Singapore social chatter
items.summary: Chinese-language entertainment outlet's recap piece (republished/recirculated late July) on actress Tian Xi Wei's Generation Gucci appearance at Marina Bay Sands, noting the look (Paparazzo and Dionysus bags) continues to be reshared across Xiaohongshu-style Chinese social content targeting Singapore's Chinese-speaking shopper base weeks after the original event.
